I couldn't compile or test the change, so it is unverified. Maven fails offline because the build-cache extension isn't downloaded, and disabling the cache didn't help.

I changed `GroupResourceTypeProvider.onDelete` in `scim/model`. The existing admin-group check only looked at the group being deleted, so deleting a regular parent still cascaded into protected admin subgroups. Now `onDelete` first walks all descendants with a new recursive `hasAdminDescendant`, using `permissions.isAdminGroup`. If any descendant is an admin group, it throws `ForbiddenException` (403) and removes nothing. I put the check in `onDelete` rather than `isManageable` so that updating a parent group isn't blocked by admin descendants.

I didn't use the axiomengine graph, since none was built for this repo. I found the code with `find` and grep instead.
